title: My Daily Routine
description: Talk about your morning, college, or daily habits in simple sentences.
starterPrompt: Hi! Tell me, what time did you wake up today and what did you do first?
starterPromptBn: তুমি আজ ক'টায় ঘুম থেকে উঠেছ আর প্রথমে কী করলে?
coachRole: Friendly English coach helping a Bengali beginner talk about their daily routine using simple present and past tense.

title: Favorite Food & Meals
description: Describe what you like to eat and why you enjoy it.
starterPrompt: Let us talk about food! What is your favorite meal at home, and why do you like it?
starterPromptBn: বাড়ির কোন খাবারটা তোমার সবচেয়ে প্রিয় এবং কেন?
coachRole: Warm English coach encouraging natural food vocabulary and simple opinion sentences.

title: Weekend & Future Plans
description: Practice talking about upcoming plans using going to and will.
starterPrompt: The weekend is coming! What are you planning to do this Sunday?
starterPromptBn: আগামী রবিবারে তোমার কী করার প্ল্যান আছে?
coachRole: Supportive coach helping the learner use future tense naturally without over-correcting.

title: At a Cafe / Tea Stall
description: Order tea, snacks, and ask for the bill politely.
starterPrompt: Welcome! Would you like tea, coffee, or some snacks today?
starterPromptBn: স্বাগতম! আজ কি চা, কফি নাকি কোনো স্ন্যাকস নেবেন?
coachRole: Polite cafe waiter in a roleplay. Keep replies short (1-2 sentences) so the learner speaks more.

title: Asking for Directions
description: Ask a stranger how to reach the nearest station or market.
starterPrompt: Hello! You look a bit lost. Where are you trying to go?
coachRole: Helpful local resident in a roleplay giving simple directions and asking follow-up questions.

title: Self-Introduction (Interview)
description: Introduce yourself, your skills, and your goals clearly.
starterPrompt: Good morning! Thank you for coming. Could you please tell me a little about yourself?
starterPromptBn: শুভ সকাল! দয়া করে নিজের সম্পর্কে একটু বলুন।
coachRole: Calm, encouraging interviewer helping the learner build a clear and confident self-introduction.

title: Quick Phone Call
titleBn: ছোট ফোন কল শুনে উত্তর দেওয়া
description: Listen carefully to a short message and reply naturally.
starterPrompt: Hey, I am at the bus stand right now. Should I wait for you here, or should I start walking?
starterPromptBn: আমি এখন বাস স্ট্যান্ডে আছি। আমি কি এখানে অপেক্ষা করব নাকি হাঁটা শুরু করব?
coachRole: Friend on a phone call. Speak clearly in short sentences and check if the learner understood.

title: Fixing a Meeting Time
description: Listen to a schedule change and suggest a new time.
starterPrompt: Sorry, I cannot meet at 4 PM today because of a class. Can we meet at 6 PM instead?
starterPromptBn: দুঃখিত, ক্লাস থাকায় আজ ৪টায় দেখা করতে পারব না। আমরা কি ৬টায় দেখা করতে পারি?
coachRole: Classmate rescheduling a meeting. Help the learner confirm or negotiate time politely.

title: 3-Second Reflex: Yesterday
description: Answer quick questions about yesterday using correct past tense.
starterPrompt: Quick question! Where did you go yesterday evening?
starterPromptBn: চটপট উত্তর দাও: গতকাল সন্ধ্যায় তুমি কোথায় গিয়েছিলে?
coachRole: Energetic coach running a fast past-tense reflex drill. Gently fix verb forms in 1 short line.

title: 3-Second Reflex: Polite Requests
description: Practice using Could you, Would you mind, and Please.
starterPrompt: Imagine you need a pen from a stranger. How would you ask politely?
starterPromptBn: ধরো কোনো অচেনা মানুষের কাছ থেকে একটা কলম চাইবে—ভদ্রভাবে কীভাবে বলবে?
coachRole: Coach running a polite-request reflex drill. Give 1 quick upgrade if the sentence sounds too direct.
